description: This script provides an interactive command-line interface to simulate battery status changes on an Android device using adb commands. It allows plugging in/off the charger and setting battery levels.
external_files: adb shell dumpsys battery set ac 1
adb shell dumpsys battery set ac 0
adb shell dumpsys battery set level <value>

methods.name: echo_run(command)
methods.description: Executes a command and prints it in a formatted manner.

methods.name: battery_unplug()
methods.description: Unplugs the device's battery using adb command.

methods.name: battery_reset()
methods.description: Resets the battery status on the device at program exit.

methods.name: interactive_start()
methods.description: Starts an interactive loop to modify battery status based on user input.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Initializes the battery simulator by unplugging the battery and starting interactivity.
